ai.title: Consolidate DB tooling to common/src/db
ai.summary: Database configuration, migrations, and client logic moved from `backend` and `web` to `common/src/db`. New scripts (`db:start`, `db:migrate`) and a Docker Compose setup automate local Postgres deployment and Drizzle migrations. Removed legacy `backend/src/db` files and updated dependencies in `common/package.json`.

eli5.text: The team moved all the database setup code from the backend and web folders into one shared folder called common/src/db, so both parts of the app now use the same database configuration. If you were looking at the backend's code, you'd notice the database files are gone, and instead there's a new setup that uses Docker and special scripts to automatically start a local database and run migrations. This means developers can now spin up the database with a single command instead of manually setting it up, and the web app's authentication code has been updated to use this shared database setup.

ai.title: Remove unused drizzle.config.ts
ai.summary: Deleted `backend/drizzle.config.ts` as it was unused. This removes the local Drizzle Kit configuration for PostgreSQL migrations. Scope limited to backend repo files. No functional impact on runtime.

eli5.text: The team removed an old configuration file used only to set up a database migration tool behind the scenes. This file lived in the backend code repository and told the Drizzle Kit tool how to connect to PostgreSQL databases when generating schema changes. Since the tool is no longer used locally and database migration setup has been centralized elsewhere, the unused config file was deleted. This change only affects developers working directly in the backend codebase; regular users will not notice any difference in functionality.

ai.title: Unify web navbar styling and layout
ai.summary: Moved inline header from `web/src/app/page.tsx` into `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`. Applied `container mx-auto px-4 py-6` classes to match previous homepage header. Updated `web/.eslintrc.js` to disable `prettier/prettier` rule.

eli5.text: The navigation bar at the top of the internal web tool's homepage now uses the same styling rules as the rest of the site's navigation bars, so it looks consistent no matter where you are. If you looked at the homepage before this change, the top bar had its own separate layout code; now that layout was moved into the shared navigation code file and given the same padding and spacing used elsewhere. This only affects the internal web app's appearance and does not change any features you can click or use, it just makes the top of the page look the same as other pages. The change is live today as part of ongoing internal cleanup.

ai.title: Disable no-explicit-any ESLint rule and remove unused Button import
ai.summary: Disables `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` in `web/.eslintrc.js` to suppress TypeScript issues. Removes unused `Button` import from `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`. Affects web linting configuration and navbar component.

eli5.text: The team turned off a strict checking rule that was flagging certain flexible code pieces, and removed a navigation button component that was no longer being used in the top menu of the web app. These are behind-the-scenes cleanup steps that tidy up the project's configuration and remove dead code, with no noticeable effect on how the app works for anyone using it today.

ai.title: Drop cloud-sql-proxy script and docs from backend
ai.summary: Removed cloud-sql-proxy setup instructions from backend/README.md and deleted the start-cloud-sql-proxy script and its dependency in the start script within backend/package.json. This simplifies local development by removing the explicit Cloud SQL Auth Proxy requirement for starting the backend. The change affects the backend package and its documentation.

eli5.text: Starting the backend no longer tries to boot the database connection helper automatically, so the local start command runs straight into the app without waiting on that background step. Developers who launch the backend locally are affected; they'll notice the startup skips the extra wiring that used to run before the app code, which means it won't attempt the credential file or proxy setup unless their environment still requires it. The change is in place today and affects local development, not deployed systems.

ai.title: Fix npm version check path and warning color
ai.summary: Removed environment check in onCheckNpmVersion, forcing package.json read from ../../. Updated backend path to ../../ and client warning color to yellow. Affects backend/src/websockets/websocket-action.ts and npm-app/src/client.ts. Version check now always reads backend package.json regardless of environment.

eli5.text: When you use the tool, it will now always check the main project's version file to see if you're running the latest version, instead of only doing that in certain setups. The warning that tells you to update, when it triggers, will now show in a yellow color instead of green. This makes the version check more consistent across different environments and the warning color more noticeable.

ai.title: Navbar and layout fixes in web app
ai.summary: Fixed navbar rendering and layout issues in web/src/app/layout.tsx, web/src/app/page.tsx, and web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx. Removed redundant div wrapper in navbar Link component. Added bg-black text-white to body className in layout.tsx. Removed duplicate bg-black text-white from page.tsx div. Semicolon removal in imports.

eli5.text: The top navigation bar on the website now renders correctly and the page layout is more consistent. The styling changes were moved to a single shared spot so the whole app uses the same background and text colors, and the navbar's logo link had an extra wrapper removed so it displays properly. These fixes are live today, so visitors will see a properly aligned navbar and uniform page background when they open the site in a browser.

ai.title: Fix light mode styling and move theme switcher
ai.summary: Light mode support added to web app. `layout.tsx` body class now uses `bg-white text-black` with `dark:` variants. `ThemeSwitcher` moved from absolute footer position to `navbar.tsx` flex container. Feature cards in `page.tsx` updated with explicit `text-white` headings and `text-gray-500` paragraphs for light mode contrast.

eli5.text: The app now supports a light-colored mode in addition to its usual dark look. When you open the site, you'll see a light background with dark text instead of the previous always-dark theme, and a toggle to switch themes has been moved from the bottom corner into the top navigation bar. This is live today for anyone visiting the web app.

ai.title: Reduce request-files-prompt file request counts
ai.summary: Adjusts `countPerRequest` from 4 to 5 and `numNonObviousPrompts` from 3 to 1 in `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` for non-assistant flows. `numKeyPrompts` also decreases from 3 to 2. These changes limit the number of file context requests generated per turn, reducing total read file calls.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant a question that isn't about code files, it now asks for fewer extra file suggestions per turn. Instead of generating up to 4 follow-up file requests at a time and 3+3 extra prompts, it requests 5 files and uses smaller sets of additional prompts. You won't see the file picker suggest as many optional files when your request doesn't already relate to source code.

ai.title: Fix applyPatch context parsing
ai.summary: Rewrote parseHunk in common/src/util/patch.ts to correctly collect context lines. Removed flawed initialContextCount logic that mishandled leading deletions. Added regression tests using delete-comment2 mock data covering import reordering and comment deletion.

eli5.text: When the system tries to apply a suggested edit to a file, it reads the edit's surrounding context lines to figure out exactly what should change. A small flaw in how those context lines were gathered could cause it to misread edits that started with deletions, potentially applying the wrong change. The logic was simplified so context is now collected consistently, and new tests were added to confirm edits that reorder imports and delete comments are applied correctly. This is a behind-the-scenes bug fix with no change to features or behavior.

ai.title: Guard null relevantFiles to skip empty file-info chunks
ai.summary: requestRelevantFiles now returns null when no new files are necessary, replacing the previous string[] return. main-prompt.ts guards on relevantFiles !== null && length > 0 before emitting the getRelevantFileInfoMessage chunk, and updateFileContext checks relevantFiles === null alongside the length test. Covers backend prompt pipeline in main-prompt.ts and request-files-prompt.ts. Eliminates a stray newline plus empty-file-info chunk that previously reached the response stream when the file set was unchanged.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant about your project files, it now skips listing files that haven't changed since your last look, instead of repeating a stale or empty list that used to print an extra blank line and a redundant 'no files needed' block in the response stream. Internally, the file-suggestion step returns a signal meaning 'nothing new,' and the response formatter checks for that signal before deciding whether to append the file summary to your reply.

eli5.text: When you interact with the CLI assistant, its responses now begin with a labelled marker that makes it visually clear the assistant is the one replying. The assistant prints the word 'Manicode' in green and underlined at the start of its replies instead of leaving a blank line. This affects anyone using the CLI-based assistant tool. If you looked, you would see that green underlined 'Manicode' text preceding the assistant's messages.

ai.title: Skip no-op file writes in knowledge generation
ai.summary: Added early return in `processFileBlock` when `newContent` matches `oldContent`, preventing unnecessary patch generation and file updates. Updated return types from `FileChange` to `FileChange | null` in `generate-knowledge-files.ts` and `main-prompt.ts` to reflect skipped operations. Added production logging for `generateKnowledgeFiles` inputs and default empty string handling in `generate-patch.ts`.

eli5.text: The assistant now skips rewriting a file when the new content is exactly the same as what is already there, so it stops doing work that would change nothing on disk. If you watched the tool while it was updating its knowledge files, you would no longer see it churn through and re-save files that had not actually been edited. The matching step now quietly returns nothing, and the rest of the system has been updated to accept that some files may simply be left alone.
